title: The Saint's Bones
text: A reliquary lies in a ruined chapel, its glass broken, its gold long stripped, the bones within unguarded and yellow as old wax. Pilgrims kneel around it in the rubble. They say the bones cure the sick, though some of the pilgrims are missing fingers.

options.label: The most hurt touches the bones and begs the saint for mercy.

outcomes.text: It works, and the pilgrims murmur. One of them hides her hand.
Nothing happens. The pilgrims look away.

options.label: Pray before the bones, among the faithful and the maimed.

outcomes.text: You pass a quiet hour among the missing fingers. No one asks for yours.

options.label: The Leader takes a finger bone; the saint has plenty.

outcomes.text: It is a true relic, though the saint may not agree to the gift.
